text: 财政部发布离岸信托个人所得税政策口径问答。 问：将非上市公司股权装入离岸信托，非上市公司股权的市场价值如何认定？ 答：《公告》发布前，个人将非上市公司股权装入离岸信托，非上市公司股权的市场价值可按照净资产核定法确定，其市场价值不能低于股权对应的净资产份额。在装入环节缴纳个人所得税后，财产原值调整为装入环节确定的市场价值。离岸信托实际转让股权时，按照财产转让收入额扣除财产原值和合理费用后的余额计算缴纳个人所得税。
text_en: The Ministry of Finance released a Q&A on the policy interpretation of individual income tax on offshore trusts. Q: How is the market value of non-listed company equity determined when such equity is contributed to an offshore trust? A: Before the release of the Announcement, where an individual contributes non-listed company equity to an offshore trust, the market value of the non-listed company equity may be determined using the net asset valuation method, and its market value shall not be lower than the share of net assets corresponding to the equity. After individual income tax is paid at the contribution stage, the original value of the property shall be adjusted to the market value determined at the contribution stage. When the offshore trust actually transfers the equity, individual income tax shall be calculated and paid on the balance of the property transfer income after deducting the original value of the property and reasonable expenses.
